case_name: Gangavva Goudappagouda Patil vs Union Of India

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: SMT.GANGAVVA GOUDAPPAGOUDA PATIL, SRI.GOUDAPPAGOUDA VEERANAGOUDA PATIL, SMT.JYOTI W/O. SIDDANAGOUDA PATIL, SMT.GEETA W/O.SIDDANAGOUDA PATIL, KUMARI KAVYA D/O. SIDDANAGOUDA PATIL
parties.respondent_defendant: UNION OF INDIA, SMT.JYOTI W/O. SIDDANAGOUDA PATIL, LIC OF INDIA

facts_of_case: The petitioners are the plaintiffs who filed an appeal against the judgment and decree dated 31.07.2020 passed in R.A.No.132/2016 on the file of the I Addl.District and Sessions Judge, Dharwad sitting at Hubballi.

legal_principles.principle: A nominee under a policy is entitled to the proceeds and benefit of the policy.
legal_principles.held: As per Section 39(11) of the Insurance Act, 1938, 'where a policyholder dies after the maturity of the policy but the proceeds and benefit of his policy has not been made to him because of his death, in such a case, his nominee shall be entitled to the proceeds and benefit of his policy'.

legal_principles.principle: A decree for divorce is a bar to subsequent proceedings for the same relief.
legal_principles.held: The petition filed in MC No.78/2003 for divorce was allowed with a direction to the said Siddanagouda Patil to pay Rs.1,250/- per month as maintenance till her lifetime.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is filed by the appellants who are the plaintiffs, aggrieved by the judgment and order dated 31.07.2020 passed in R.A.No.132/2016 clubbed with R.A.No.119/2016.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in joint family disputes
